questions.question: How do I change the address on my driving licence?
key_facts: It does not cost anything to change your address with DVLA
You can apply online (or by post)
You can still drive while you're waiting for your new licence
You must also change the address on your vehicle log book (V5C) and update your vehicle tax Direct Debit
You can be fined up to £1,000 if you do not tell DVLA when your address changes

questions.question: How much does it cost to renew my driving licence when I turn 70?
key_facts: Renewing online with DVLA is free if you're 70 or over, or will be 70 in the next 90 days
Once you reach 70, you must renew every 3 years

questions.question: How old do I have to be to apply for a provisional driving licence?
key_facts: You must be at least 15 years and 9 months old
It costs £34 when you apply online (£43 by post using form D1)

questions.question: How much does it cost to replace a stolen driving licence?
key_facts: A new licence costs £20 online
You should contact the police if your driving licence is stolen
Your licence should arrive within a week if you apply online

questions.question: How long do penalty points stay on my licence?
key_facts: Endorsements must stay on your driving record for 4 or 11 years, depending on the offence
You can be disqualified if you build up 12 or more penalty points within 3 years

questions.question: How much does the car theory test cost?
key_facts: Car theory test costs £23 (motorcycle also £23)

questions.question: How do I tell DVLA my car is off the road?
key_facts: Tell DVLA you're taking your vehicle off the road (a SORN)
You get a refund for any full months of remaining tax
You cannot use the vehicle on the road until you tax it again
You can apply online using the 11-digit V5C number or the 16-digit number on the tax reminder

questions.question: Can I get a refund on my vehicle tax if I sell my car?
key_facts: Cancel vehicle tax by telling DVLA the vehicle was sold or transferred (or SORN, scrapped, written off etc.); there's no other way to cancel
You get a refund for any full months of remaining tax
A Direct Debit is cancelled automatically
No refund for credit card fees or the 5% / 10% surcharges

questions.question: Which vehicles are exempt from vehicle tax?
key_facts: Exempt vehicles include vehicles used by a disabled person, historic vehicles made before 1 January 1986, mobility vehicles and powered wheelchairs, mowing machines, steam vehicles, and agricultural/horticultural/forestry vehicles
From 1 April 2025 electric cars, vans, motorcycles and tricycles must pay vehicle tax; only HGVs over 3,500kg stay exempt
You must tax your vehicle even if you do not have to pay

questions.question: How do I check the MOT history of a car?
key_facts: You need the vehicle's number plate (registration number)
For cars, motorcycles and vans you can get results for tests done since 2005
The history shows pass/fail, recorded mileage and when the next MOT is due

questions.question: How early can I get my MOT without losing my renewal date?
key_facts: You can get an MOT up to a month (minus a day) before it runs out and keep the same renewal date
Example: if the MOT runs out on 15 May, the earliest to keep the same date is 16 April
Earlier than that, the next renewal date becomes one year (minus a day) from the pass date

questions.question: What do I need to do when I sell my car?
key_facts: Tell DVLA you no longer own the vehicle (online, or by post if there's no log book)
Your vehicle tax will be cancelled
You'll get a refund for any full months of remaining vehicle tax

questions.question: How do I change the address on my V5C log book?
key_facts: It's usually free to update your V5C
You can change it online as the registered keeper to a new UK address, or by post (section 3 on new style log book, section 6 on old style)
If your vehicle needs taxing in the next 4 weeks, tax it online before changing the address
You can be fined up to £1,000 if you do not tell DVLA when your address changes

questions.question: What should I do if my car has been stolen?
key_facts: Tell the police (dial 101) and your insurance company straight away
Have the registration number, make and model, and colour ready
You'll get a crime reference number to give your insurer
If the insurer pays out, you must tell DVLA the vehicle was sold to the insurance company

questions.question: What are the penalties for speeding?
key_facts: The minimum penalty is a £100 fine and 3 penalty points
You could be disqualified with 12 or more points within 3 years
In court the fine is usually a percentage of weekly income, up to £1,000 (£2,500 on a motorway)
New drivers within 2 years of passing lose their licence at 6 or more points

questions.question: How do I get my licence back after a driving ban?
key_facts: You must apply for a new licence to drive again after disqualification or revocation
For drink or drug driving you can reapply before the disqualification ends; DVLA sends a D27 form 56 days before (90 days for high risk offenders)
You cannot drive until the disqualification period is over
New drivers whose licence is cancelled within 2 years of passing must apply for a new provisional licence and retake both parts of the driving test

questions.question: Can I drive if I have diabetes?
key_facts: You must tell DVLA if insulin treatment lasts (or will last) over 3 months, or you get disabling hypoglycaemia
Report online or fill in form DIAB1 (car or motorbike licence)
You do not need to tell DVLA if the diabetes is treated by diet changes only
You can be fined up to £1,000 if you do not tell DVLA about a condition affecting your driving

questions.question: What are the eyesight rules for driving?
key_facts: You must be able to read a number plate from 20 metres away (with glasses or contact lenses if you use them)
Minimum visual acuity of at least decimal 0.5 (6/12) on the Snellen scale, plus an adequate field of vision
You must wear glasses or contact lenses every time you drive if you need them

questions.question: How do I change the photo on my driving licence?
key_facts: It costs £14 when you apply online (£17 by post; no fee if over 70)
You can use your passport photo or upload a new one
A photocard licence must be renewed every 10 years
You cannot renew online if your name or title has changed or you have a 5-year bus or lorry licence

questions.question: What do the codes on my driving licence mean?
key_facts: Codes printed on the back of the licence say what conditions you must meet to drive
Examples: 01 eyesight correction; 78 restricted to automatic transmission; 70 exchange of licence; 71 duplicate of licence; 115 organ donor

questions.question: How do I swap my paper driving licence for a photocard?
key_facts: You only must get a new licence if you change address or name, want to do Driver CPC training, or the licence is defaced, lost, stolen or destroyed
It is free if you changed your name or address and still have your paper licence
It costs £20 if lost, stolen, destroyed, defaced or for any other reason
You cannot apply online if you changed your name; apply by post with D1 (car/bike) or D2 (lorry/bus)

questions.question: How much does the driving test cost?
key_facts: Car driving test costs £62 on weekdays and £75 evenings, weekends and bank holidays
Car theory test costs £23
You have to pay the full amount again to rebook after failing

questions.question: How do I change my driving test appointment?
key_facts: You can change a car driving test 2 times (6 times for other types of test)
You must change your car driving test yourself; your instructor is not allowed to
Changing more than one thing at once counts as one change
To change for free give 10 full working days' notice for car tests
If you need more changes you must cancel and book a new test

questions.question: How do I tax a car if I haven't received a tax reminder?
key_facts: You can use the 11-digit reference from your V5C if you are the current keeper, or the 12-digit reference on the green new keeper slip
You can also tax by phone (0300 123 4321) or at a Post Office
If you have neither V5C nor new keeper slip, a new V5C costs £25 (current keeper can tax at the same time)

questions.question: I've just bought a used car. What do I need to do to tax it and get it registered in my name?
key_facts: Tax the vehicle before you drive it, or declare it off the road (SORN); tax is not transferred when you buy a vehicle
Tax using the V5C reference or the 12-digit green new keeper slip number
If no V5C for the new vehicle, apply with form V62 plus the new keeper slip
If bought without a log book, apply for a registration certificate (V62)

questions.question: I'm moving house. Which of my licence and vehicle records do I need to update?
key_facts: Change the address on your driving licence (free; fine up to £1,000 if you do not tell DVLA)
Update the vehicle log book V5C (usually free)
Update your vehicle tax Direct Debit if you pay that way
Update your personalised registration number document (V750 or V778) if you have one

questions.question: My car is over 40 years old. Does it need an MOT, and does it need vehicle tax?
key_facts: No MOT needed if the vehicle was built or first registered more than 40 years ago and has had no substantial changes
Vehicle tax exemption applies to vehicles built before 1 January 1986 (from 1 April 2026); if build date unknown, registered before 8 January 1986
You must apply for the exemption and still tax the vehicle even if you do not pay
Exempt vehicle must be kept roadworthy; up to £2,500 fine and 3 points for dangerous condition

questions.question: I'm 17 and want to learn to drive. What licence and tests do I need, and what do they cost?
key_facts: Apply for a provisional licence from 15 years and 9 months; £34 online
You can usually start driving a car when you're 17
You must have a provisional licence and be supervised with L plates
Theory test £23 for cars; driving test £62 weekdays / £75 evenings and weekends
No minimum number of lessons

questions.question: My car has been written off. What do I tell DVLA and what happens to my vehicle tax?
key_facts: You must tell DVLA if the vehicle was written off and scrapped by your insurer; you can be fined £1,000 if you do not
Use the 11-digit reference in the yellow 'sell, transfer or part-exchange to the motor trade' section of the V5C
Take any personalised registration number off the vehicle
You get a tax refund for any full months left; a Direct Debit is cancelled automatically

questions.question: I'm over 70 and have a medical condition. How do I renew my driving licence?
key_facts: Renew online free from 70 (or within 90 days of turning 70) if you meet the eyesight requirement and are not prevented from driving
Renew every 3 years after 70
You must tell DVLA about medical conditions that affect driving, or be fined up to £1,000
You can drive while the renewal is processed only if your doctor supports you continuing to drive and other conditions are met

How many times can I change my car driving test booking now?
key_facts: Since 31 March 2026 you can only make 2 changes to a car driving test booking (previously 6)
Changing the date, time or test centre counts as a change, as does swapping with another learner; changing several things at once counts as one
Address or contact detail updates, adding or removing the instructor reference, and changes DVSA makes (e.g. bad weather) do not count
After 2 changes you must cancel and book a new test (full refund if at least 10 full working days before)

questions.question: Can my driving instructor book or cancel my driving test for me?
key_facts: Since 12 May 2026 only the learner can book, change, swap or cancel their own car driving test
It is against the law for a driving instructor or anyone else to book a test for someone
Instructors can still set their availability using the instructor reference number
Tests already booked by instructors remain valid

questions.question: If I want to move my driving test to a different test centre, where can I move it to?
key_facts: Since 9 June 2026 you can only move your test to one of the 3 nearest test centres to where it is booked, or the centre you first booked at
For bookings made before 9 June 2026 the rule applies to where the test was booked on 9 June 2026
Moving counts as one of your 2 allowed changes

questions.question: The mileage on my MOT record is wrong. How do I get it corrected?
key_facts: Use the online form if the MOT was more than 28 days ago; within 28 days ask the MOT centre / see how to report it
You must upload evidence of the correct mileage: invoice, emissions printout, service receipt, service history, or job card/inspection sheet
The document must show the registration number or VIN, the mileage, and a date within one day of the MOT test
An MOT certificate or a photo of the dashboard cannot be used as evidence
You'll usually get a reply within 8 weeks

questions.question: How do I set up a Direct Debit to pay my vehicle tax?
key_facts: Set up a Direct Debit when you tax your vehicle online or at a Post Office
You need your address and date of birth and your bank or building society name, account number and sort code
5% surcharge for paying monthly or every 6 months; no surcharge yearly
You cannot use an account that needs 2 signatures
First payment is not taken until the tax has started; later payments on the first working day of the month
